relationships.evidence: RIVM documents use of SimaPro 9.5 for the current modelling update.
PlasticsEurope states that most aggregated datasets are available in the SimaPro industrial database.
SHDB licenses support use in SimaPro and other LCA software.
ESU sells all system processes as a SimaPro background library.
relationships.constraints: Commercial licences and version compatibility apply.
relationships.validation_question: Record SimaPro and database release pair.

relationships.status: Implemented and fixture-tested in TIDAS Tools v0.2.0
relationships.evidence: The public CLI tests import a SimaPro 9.5 CSV fixture, validate TIDAS output and emit deterministic mapping.csv.gz.
relationships.constraints: The endpoint is SimaPro CSV, not the whole software model; dialects vary and no reverse/lossless claim is made.
relationships.validation_question: Test CSV exports from several named SimaPro releases and compare formula, unit and uncertainty coverage.
